title: Tracing Mystery Network Traffic with eBPF Across HRT's Global Compute Cluster
summary: Hudson River Trading engineers used eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) to diagnose and trace mysterious network traffic patterns across their global compute cluster, a critical challenge in high-frequency trading environments where understanding every byte of network communication is essential for performance and security.
problem_solved: Debugging unknown network traffic patterns in a production trading cluster without modifying applications or disrupting low-latency trading operations.
why_valuable: eBPF enables kernel-level network observability without application changes, providing zero-downtime debugging capabilities essential for latency-sensitive trading systems.
